system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Storage bucket for hosting a static website.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Storage bucket for hosting a static website.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: static-website-bucket
  type: storage.v1.bucket
  properties:
    name: my-static-website-bucket-prod
    location: US
    storageClass: STANDARD
    website:
      mainPageSuffix: index.html
      notFoundPage: 404.html
    iamConfiguration:
      uniformBucketLevelAccess:
        enabled: true
      publicAccessPrevention: inherited
    versioning:
      enabled: true
    lifecycle:
      rule:
      - action:
          type: Delete
        condition:
          numNewerVersions: 5
      - action:
          type: SetStorageClass
          storageClass: NEARLINE
        condition:
          age: 30
          isLive: false
    cors:
    - origin:
      - "https://example.com"
      method:
      - GET
      - HEAD
      responseHeader:
      - Content-Type
      maxAgeSeconds: 3600
    logging:
      logBucket: my-static-website-logs-prod
      logObjectPrefix: access-logs/
    labels:
      environment: production
      purpose: static-website
      managed-by: deployment-manager

- name: static-website-logs-bucket
  type: storage.v1.bucket
  properties:
    name: my-static-website-logs-prod
    location: US
    storageClass: STANDARD
    iamConfiguration:
      uniformBucketLevelAccess:
        enabled: true
      publicAccessPrevention: enforced
    lifecycle:
      rule:
      - action:
          type: Delete
        condition:
          age: 90
    labels:
      environment: production
      purpose: access-logs
      managed-by: deployment-manager

- name: static-website-bucket-public-read
  type: gcp-types/storage-v1:virtual.buckets.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    bucket: $(ref.static-website-bucket.name)
    role: roles/storage.objectViewer
    member: allUsers

outputs:
- name: bucketName
  value: $(ref.static-website-bucket.name)
- name: bucketSelfLink
  value: $(ref.static-website-bucket.selfLink)
- name: websiteUrl
  value: https://storage.googleapis.com/$(ref.static-website-bucket.name)/index.html
- name: logsBucketName
  value: $(ref.static-website-logs-bucket.name)
